scope: IDEA000036/037/039/040/041 only; raw proposals and operative registries unchanged.

graph_check.assessment: All retained relation edges are related_to, not duplicate_of. Existing reasons preserve distinct units, rivals, and falsifiers.

items.title: Figure labels track process state rather than biography
items.correction: Approve as distinct from 39/40, but its state-versus-biography prediction is identifiable only with independent owner, state, and material labels plus crossed state/owner cells. A comparator saying figures may be personified materials is contextual motivation, not Voynich semantic binding.

source_evidence.quote:
The q13 apparatus pages most plausibly describe a **medicinal-alchemical
circulation, separation, and staged-transformation system**.  Their human
figures are provisionally better modeled as personified materials or process
states inside an apparatus than as a literal catalogue of bathers.

items.title: A repeated complete form codes a class or slot, not a unique member
items.correction: Approve as distinct from 39: class/slot invariance versus unique member/ordinal is a different endpoint. Require independently coded class/slot labels and owner masking; a repeated form can satisfy both class and owner descriptions when labels are collinear.

items.title: A repeated diagram whole denotes a component or state key rather than an object
items.correction: Approve as distinct from 37 and 41, with a required three-way crossed design: shared stage/state across changing owners, while component and topology vary independently. A locus may simultaneously be a component/state key and a return/junction, so recurrence alone cannot choose them.

source_evidence.quote:
Met 55.121.11 is the closest readable technical-rendering comparator yet.  It
combines a water source, repeated lifting components, a driving animal, shafts
and wheels, and numerous compact marks beside parts.  The reverse is
especially informative: four parallel lifting bays sit under a shared drive,
showing that repeated visual units can be components or stages of one machine
rather than four independent named objects.

## Architectural consequence

This establishes a historically real alternative for q13 graphical text:
some diagram-local strings could function as references into explanatory prose
or as component/state keys, not as ordinary object names.  That alternative is
more compatible with q13's mixed labels/prose and weak one-object ownership
than a naive label dictionary.

items.title: A figure-linked whole selects treatment mode rather than a person or material
items.correction: Approve as distinct from 36: mode/procedure position is the target while figure/material are controls. GDT210 post-hoc comparator leads do not bind Voynich mode labels; held crossed modes and owners are required. This is underdetermined, not impossible in principle.

source_evidence.quote:
Across the transparent post-hoc comparison, 6 axes are specific
leads for the bath theory and 1 is a secondary lead for the
alchemical/hydraulic theory. No composite score or p-value is claimed.

items.title: A diagram whole marks a return-loop or branch junction
items.correction: Approve as distinct from 39: topology enrichment versus stage/state recurrence has a different endpoint, but the same locus can satisfy both. Independent graph coding and crossed component/owner/topology cells are required; historical comparator machinery is not label gold.

source_evidence.quote:
Direct source-bound inspection found genuine quintessence-tradition machinery:

- Wolfenbüttel fol. 40r shows two connected pear-shaped vessels with crossing
  ducts;
- Othmer fol. 10r shows a return-loop vessel and a second vessel with paired
  internal descending ducts;
- Othmer fol. 36r shows paired domed furnaces, nested chambers, fire, and side
  outlets.

This is materially better evidence than a generic claim that medieval
alchemy used vessels. It supports circulation, paired-container, nested-
apparatus, and side-duct geometry as authentic technical imagery near the
Voynich period.

global_correction: Crossed independent labels can distinguish the restricted models when source-bound endpoints and non-collinear cells are available. Current designs correctly mark those endpoints unavailable; this is a readiness limitation, not a claim that meaning can never be inferred. Historical comparator reports motivate rivals but do not supply Voynich semantic gold.
